subject.name: Campaign Engine
subject.description: Terminal execution layer of the LCS pipeline. Sequences outreach messages (MIDs) based on movement detection — no movement = 1 monthly touch (stay visible), movement detected = 3-5 touches over 2 weeks (get the meeting). Receives CID targets from Process 100, evaluates movement signals from Process 200, tags MIDs, routes to Mailgun (email) or HeyReach (LinkedIn) via Composio.
subject.src_state: empty — no source code. Process is documentation-only at BUILD stage.

scope: Validate Process 700's PROCESS.md against the unified template v6.0.0 invariant set (24 layers across 3 clusters: Identity/Contract/Governance mapped to Thing/Flow/Change) and Grid Reader requirements. The US handoff defines 10 invariant-set comparators across layers L1-L24. This run evaluates whether the existing PROCESS.md satisfies each layer's structure and content requirements.
boundary_exclusions: Upstream process documents (100, 200) — referenced but not evaluated
Composio/Mailgun/HeyReach external services — referenced but not evaluated
D1 and Neon database schemas — referenced but not validated here
Campaign content templates — documented as not started, not in scope for structure validation
intent: Validate Process 700 (Campaign Engine) against unified template v6.0.0 and Grid Reader requirements. Assess each of the 10 invariant-set layers from the US handoff against the actual PROCESS.md content. Identify structural gaps, missing layers, and deviations from the invariant set. Run 1 of minimum 3 — no lock possible.

services: CF Worker (lcs-hub — same worker as Process 100)
acceptance_criteria: Tags every MID with path_type + channel + movement_signal + sequence_position
Sequences movement campaigns over 2 weeks (3-5 touches every 2-3 days)
Monthly generic touch for non-movement companies
Errors write to master error table (D1)
Every MID traces to a CID — no orphans
ORBT strike tracking on repeated failures

present_and_structured: L1 — Document exists at declared CTB position with all three cluster headers
L5 — Process Identity table present with HEIR fields (via heir.yaml + Section 1)
L6 — Purpose section present (Section 2) with downstream dependency named
L7 — Resources present (Sections 4, 8 cover tools, secrets, dependencies)
L8 — IMO Declaration present (Section 3) with Two-Question Intake, Middle table (5 steps), Output, Circle
L9 — Data Schema present (Section 5) with READ, WRITE, Join Chain, Forbidden Paths
L11 — C&V Declaration present (Section 6) with constants list, variables list, and mathematical definitions
L12 — Guard Rails present (Section 7) with 10 stop conditions (exceeds canonical 6)
L13 — Verification present (Section 9) with 7 numbered steps and Three Primitives Check
gaps_for_downstream_agents: L10 — Structure Extraction (DMJ): No explicit Define/Map/Join tables. Section 6 has C&V but not the DMJ three-step structure (L19 Define table, L20 Map table, L21 Join table). The join chain in Section 5 partially covers L21 but not in DMJ format.

L14 — Measurement partially present: Section 10 has metrics table (L22) and sigma tracking placeholder (L23), but ORBT Gate Rules (L24) are embedded as a note rather than a structured 3-column table (From/To/Gate).
L15 — Execution Trace: No 14-field per-step trace schema declared. Section 11 (Logbook) is session-level, not step-level execution trace.
L16 — Certification Record: Not present. Process is in BUILD so this is expected (no logbook during BUILD per Bedrock Section 8), but the schema should still be declared.
L17 — Fleet Learning: Section 12 (Known Issues & Strike Tracking) covers failure tracking but not in the Failure Pattern Registry 7-column format.
L18 — Session History: Section 13 present but uses 3 columns (Date/What/Doc) — matches L18 format.
